objective: Complete the agent-tui OpenCode serve renderer and lifecycle closeout while preserving the Cordis plugin structure, child-project governance truth, and real global-entry verification boundary.

boundary.payload_control_separation: OpenCode business messages and event payloads remain separate from routing, retry, lifecycle, debug, snapshot, environment, cancellation, and governance control truth; control data uses typed side channels or project records only.

acceptance_criteria: The existing Cordis transport -> semantic presentation -> turn state -> render snapshot -> terminal carrier chain remains the sole adjacent path.
SSE deltas, reasoning, tool call/wait/result, startup/history progress, animation, and composer input publish independently without blocking one another.
Esc stops only the current turn, Ctrl+C exits only the UI, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, and running Tab/Enter follow the declared queue semantics.
The built artifact and /opt/homebrew/bin/agent-tui global entry are identical to the tested source commit and pass real OpenCode serve PTY verification.
AppSDK governance truth, historical evidence, maps, locks, ReviewRecord, FreezeRecord, and hashes are preserved and verified through official local AppSDK commands.
non_goals: Do not modify agent-memory, Teams, OpenCode Host, dsh-multikey-provider, or other worker worktrees.
Do not restore DSH compatibility or add a fallback path.
Do not hand-edit project version, sdk.lock, migration records, lifecycle records, evidence, receipts, timestamps, producer identity, or hashes.
Do not start review, admission, merge, publish, freeze, or cleanup before runtime evidence and governance gates are valid.
assumptions: This directory is the agent-tui project root and origin/main is the clean source baseline.
OpenCode serve is the sole host integration and the installed global agent-tui entry is the user-observable boundary.
AppSDK 0.1.6 local verification is authoritative; binary byte identity is not a governance admission requirement.

questions.question: Is this a new project, module refactor, project refactor, or debug task?
questions.answer: Debug and runtime closeout for the existing agent-tui OpenCode adaptor and renderer/lifecycle chain.

questions.question: Which relative directory is the AppSDK project root?
questions.answer: The current agent-tui directory, relative path .

questions.question: Which existing directories remain read-only and outside the new project?
questions.answer: The parent repository's agent-memory, Teams, deepseek-harness, opencode reference, root collaboration records, and other worker worktrees remain outside this task.

questions.question: Which directories may the new project create or modify?
questions.answer: Only the declared agent-tui source, contracts, tests, scripts, package/build files, and official AppSDK governance surface in this worktree.

questions.question: What proves runtime completion?
questions.answer: A rebuilt and globally installed /opt/homebrew/bin/agent-tui verified against a real OpenCode serve endpoint through fresh PTY startup, streaming, tool, history, input, restart, and exit scenarios.
